headline: AI Search relies 70-80% on 3rd-party citations; Google fixes 'Recent' filter bug and updates GSC link data

Confirmed Search Updates.what_happened: Google resolves bug in Search and News "Recent" filter tools | Google 修复了搜索和新闻“最近”过滤工具的故障
Confirmed Search Updates.why_it_matters: 此前用户和 SEO 发现使用 Tools > Recent（如过去一小时）过滤时无法返回正确结果。Google 官方（Rajan Patel）已确认于 8 月 2 日上午部署了修复程序。
Confirmed Search Updates.evidence_detail: Google's Rajan Patel confirmed on X that the team shipped a fix on the morning of August 2nd, resolving the issue where filtering Google Search or Google News results by recent time frames (e.g., past hour) failed to return expected results.
Confirmed Search Updates.what_to_do: 无需操作，该 Bug 已由 Google 官方修复，可恢复正常的新闻与实时内容监控。

SERP & Algorithm Signals.what_happened: Google Search Console updates link report data on August 1st | Google Search Console 于 8 月 1 日更新了链接报告数据
SERP & Algorithm Signals.why_it_matters: GSC 的链接报告（Links Report）数据已更新。由于 Google 持续调整该报告的抽样和展示逻辑，SEO 可能会在后台看到外链总数或域名数的波动，这属于正常的数据刷新。
SERP & Algorithm Signals.evidence_detail: Barry Schwartz documented that Google refreshed the Search Console links report data on August 1st, 2026. This is part of Google's periodic data updates for the legacy links report, which often results in visible fluctuations in reported backlink counts.
SERP & Algorithm Signals.what_to_do: 检查 GSC 链接报告，记录外链数据的变化，避免因数据刷新引起的外链暴跌误判。

Technical SEO Experiments.what_happened: Cloudflare launches "Agents Week" focusing on infrastructure for autonomous AI agents | Cloudflare 开启“Agent 周”，聚焦面向自主 AI Agent 的云基础设施
Technical SEO Experiments.why_it_matters: 标志着网络基础设施向“Agent 原生 Web”（Agent-native web）转型的开始。未来网站不仅需要服务人类浏览器，更需要提供适合 AI Agent 存储、执行和安全的底层接口，这将重塑技术 SEO 的边界。
Technical SEO Experiments.evidence_detail: Cloudflare officially announced 'Agents Week' to explore how cloud infrastructure must evolve (including storage, execution, and security primitives) to serve autonomous AI agents rather than traditional human browsers.
Technical SEO Experiments.what_to_do: 保持关注 Cloudflare 本周发布的技术标准与安全产品，评估未来如何为 AI Agent 提供无障碍、结构化的数据读取接口。

Technical SEO Experiments.what_happened: Google may miss updated dates if pages with "unavailable_after" are not recrawled | 若页面未被重新抓取，Google 可能会忽略更新后的 unavailable_after 截止日期
Technical SEO Experiments.why_it_matters: 如果你使用 `unavailable_after` 元标记来控制过期内容的索引，一旦你更新了该日期，但 Googlebot 没有及时重新抓取该页面，Google 将无法识别新日期，导致页面按旧日期被移出索引。
Technical SEO Experiments.evidence_detail: Highlighted in Aleyda Solis's SEOFOMO digest, the technical limitation of the `unavailable_after` tag is that Google cannot process an updated expiration date if it does not recrawl the page before the original expiration date passes.
Technical SEO Experiments.what_to_do: 在更新 `unavailable_after` 日期后，必须通过 GSC 提交手动抓取请求，或通过 API/XML 网站地图强力引导 Googlebot 重新抓取该页面。

AI Search / GEO.what_happened: Study: AI Search citations are 70-80% third-party domains across SaaS, finance, and ecommerce | 研究：SaaS、金融和电商领域的 AI 搜索引用中，70-80% 均来自第三方域名
AI Search / GEO.why_it_matters: 证实了 AI 搜索（如 Google AI Mode, Gemini, ChatGPT）主要是一个第三方引用（Digital PR 与社交媒体）的问题，品牌官网仅占少数。不同行业和平台的引用来源偏好差异显著（如 SaaS 偏向社交，金融偏向媒体/对比，AI Mode 最偏向社交）。
AI Search / GEO.evidence_detail: Aleyda Solis analyzed Semrush Enterprise data for the top 10 cited source domains of 15 leading brands across SaaS, ecommerce, and finance. The study found external domain citation shares of 82.3% for SaaS, 79.4% for finance, and 69.6% for ecommerce. It also noted that Google's AI Mode is highly social-led, while ChatGPT is more evaluative/written, and Gemini is mixed.
AI Search / GEO.what_to_do: 针对目标 AI 平台和行业属性，协同 Digital PR、社交媒体与 On-page SEO，在第三方高权重引用源（如 Reddit、行业媒体、对比网站）中建立品牌提及与协同验证。

sources.name: aleyda
sources.excerpt: 📊 AI Search Is a 3rd-Party Citation Problem With an On-Page Corroboration Base: The Data Across SaaS, Ecommerce and Finance 👇 But is this true across different verticals and AI platforms? How much weight should we give to digital PR vs social? To assess it, I analyzed the top 10 cited source domains for 15 leading brands across SaaS, ecommerce and finance in Google AI Mode, Gemini and ChatGPT, using @semrush Enterprise data: 1. AI search is primarily a 3rd-party citation problem The most consistent finding is that the brand's own website is a minority of the top cited source mix in every vertical. AI Search / GEO.what_happened: Google surfaces "Top Stories" and "Preferred Sources" in AI Overviews | Google 在 AI Overviews 中展示“焦点新闻”与“首选来源”
AI Search / GEO.why_it_matters: 针对新闻和实时性查询，Google 正在 AI Overviews (AIO) 中更频繁地嵌入 Top Stories 模块，并突出显示“首选来源”（Preferred Sources）。这为新闻出版商在 AI 搜索时代保留流量提供了关键入口。
AI Search / GEO.evidence_detail: SEO consultant Glenn Gabe observed the integration of Top Stories modules and 'Preferred Sources' within AI Overviews for news-related queries, advising publishers to actively monitor these placements.
AI Search / GEO.what_to_do: 针对高流量的新闻和时效性关键词，监控 AIO 中 Top Stories 模块的出现频率，并优化 Google News 准入与结构化数据以争取“首选来源”曝光。

Playbook: Worth Testing.what_happened: Playbook: Leverage Bing Merchant Center product feeds to capture free listings in Bing AI and ChatGPT | 玩法：利用 Bing Merchant Center 商品 Feed 捕获 Bing AI 和 ChatGPT 的免费商品列表流量
Playbook: Worth Testing.why_it_matters: 随着 ChatGPT 和 Bing AI 深度整合商品 Feed，电商 AI SEO 的未来在于结构化商品数据。通过优化 Bing Merchant Center，可以直接影响 AI 搜索中的商品推荐和免费展示。
Playbook: Worth Testing.evidence_detail: Brodie Clark conducted testing and compared Google and Bing Merchant Centers, highlighting a case study with significant results for free product listings on Bing. The analysis emphasizes ChatGPT's integration of product feeds, suggesting a transition toward relying solely on direct feed integrations for free product listings.
Playbook: Worth Testing.what_to_do: 导入并优化 Bing Merchant Center 的商品 Feed，确保数据完整性，并监控 Bing Webmaster Tools 中的免费商品列表表现。
Playbook: Worth Testing.how_to_test: 将现有的 Google Merchant Center 商品 Feed 导入 Bing Merchant Center，启用 Free Product Listings，并优化商品属性（如品牌、价格、GTIN）。
Playbook: Worth Testing.success_metric: Bing Webmaster Tools 中 Free Listings 的曝光量/点击量，以及来自 ChatGPT/Bing AI 的引流。
Playbook: Worth Testing.effort: 中等。需要配置 Feed 同步与属性映射，无技术风险。

sources.name: brodieseo
sources.excerpt: The future of Ecommerce AI SEO is in product feeds. This is the article to read to stay ahead of the trend. I spent many hours learning about and testing in Microsoft's Merchant Center so you don’t have to. There’s a case study in here that has some eye-opening results for free product listings on Bing. Within the article, I compare and contrast Google to Bing’s Merchant Center, showing steps for accessing key reports, importing your feeds, relevant free listing surfaces, and more. Including some details on the introduction of product feeds in ChatGPT, with it being highly likely that they will eventually rely solely on their own product feed integration for free listings. Read here:…
sources.author: @brodieseo

Today's Action Items.what_to_do: 针对 AI 搜索引用占比（70-80% 为第三方），评估并协同 Digital PR 与社交媒体团队，在 Reddit、行业媒体等高权重第三方源中建立品牌提及。
电商站点尝试将商品 Feed 导入 Bing Merchant Center，优化属性以捕获 Bing AI 和 ChatGPT 的免费商品列表流量。
若使用 `unavailable_after` 标记，更新日期后务必手动提交 GSC 抓取，防止 Google 因未重新抓取而误删索引。
